research_notes: Initial research: official biography, own 2018 speech, first speech, government ministerial biography, contemporaneous union and hotel-association annual reports, publisher profile and reliable secondary student-job lead reviewed.

Full-time entry to the union is explicit but excluded under the codebook. It cannot supply private or public headline years. Missing paralegal dates and hours prevent treating private employment as zero.

Follow-up: primary DBH historical staff material and university-era employment dates/pay/hours; union legal-officer/secretary transition and leave; Social Inclusion Board appointment reports; Centre for Work and Life advisory appointment dates/pay; author contracts/working time if relevant.

A GamingCare advisory-chair claim appeared in a third-party profile. AHA 2006 annual report names Jane Jeffreys as GamingCare chair; this may concern different bodies. Do not add Butler’s alleged chair role without direct corroboration.

Recovered source restrictions: Advertiser direct URL restricted; older personal about URL inaccessible. Indexed reliable excerpt used only for the narrow paralegal fact. No access-control bypass attempted.

Follow-up2026-10-02: historical branch accounts establish previously unrecorded branch-executive governance and national-council control, distinct from national executive. Reporting period is not converted into appointment bounds. No individual full-time status or remuneration can be allocated from aggregates.

ABC secretary-after1997 chronology conflicts with eleven-year recollection; seek appointment/election return before splitting1992–2007. Student paralegal dates/hours and advisory board terms remain unknown after DBH, Social Inclusion, university and GamingCare searches.
SA20November2007Hansard returned403; ordinary financial-report download timed out but web PDF text was readable. These source errors did not terminate research.

Follow-up2026-10-03: targeted SocialInclusionBoard, Centre forWorkandLife, LHMUappointment and legal-officer searches found no new primary appointment instrument, payroll fact or personal hours. The restricted2015Advertiser article could not be opened; search results and derivative pages repeat a1996state-secretary and legal-officer narrative, while ABC retains 'after1997'. Without the underlying appointment return, the existing conflict was preserved and no exact transition added. Namesake academic and US profiles were excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Inspected primaryAHA(SA)2006financial/operating report again for GamingCare lead: opening president report names JaneJeffreys GamingCare chair, not Butler. Derivative conference biography may concern distinct advisory committee or other period; do not merge roles or invent tenure. Exact SocialInclusionBoard/Gazette and Centre-for-Work-and-Life searches yielded no personal appointment endpoints;2005research-interview lead is an observation, not appointment. DBHparalegal and union-secretary chronology still unresolved by primary individual records; Cairns/Townsville solicitor and mental-health practitioner namesakes excluded. No new substantive career fact.

Follow-up2026-10-05: primary DPC2006–07 accounts establish Social Inclusion Board remuneration entitlement and IR Advisory Committee membership; three Gazettes provide separate IRAC appointment starts/scheduled terms and another confirms Tourism Commission directorship. Actual exits not inferred from expiry; no gap filling or full-time/title inference. Conference2012 adds unnamed gambling/vocational-training governance requiring entity identification. Targeted searches for revocation/training board produced no individual evidence; US/Irish namesakes excluded. APH workplace inquiry witness page returned403; indexed industrial-officer lead remains unverified. DPC ordinary download403 recovered using accessible web PDF. Paralegal legal employer/dates/hours, union secretary chronology/leave and university advisory endpoints remain unresolved; retain null totals.
